items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Fred Clough often did our sessions.

ctx.x: Fred Clough often did our sessions. We had to do three albums a year. That was my contract, and I never missed, that I can remember, in 17 years at Columbia.
I think you did more. I think if you – I look at the discography. I’ve done a count. You did at least three a year, sometimes more.
